biggest_gaps: Trade-offs are thin: the new article mentions a learning curve but doesn't explain the practical costs of cup care (access to clean water/private washing facilities, cleaning becoming part of the routine, heavier days needing earlier emptying) the way the benchmark does.
Voice is more list-and-answer than the benchmark's reassuring, reader-directed tone; add a short framing paragraph that acknowledges cleaning can feel like a chore and that a mix of products is fine.
Caution could be broadened: the benchmark flags IUD/pelvic pain and advises checking with a health professional before use, not only stopping if pain occurs; mirror that pre-use caution.
what_new_does_well: Clean, scannable structure with clear daily vs between-cycle sections and a useful FAQ block that matches search intent.
Accurately sticks to supplied product facts (capacities, 8-hour wear, materials, lifespan, colours) without inventing claims.
Good caution on what to avoid and a clear not-medical-advice disclaimer.
